content: Annotators disagreed on 3441 (44.2%) of questions. Primary sources of disagreement before resolution included each annotator choosing a single category for questions requiring multiple labels (e.g. annotator 1 assigning a label of X, and annotator 2 assigning a label of Y, when the gold label was multilabel X, Y), which was observed in 18% of disagreements. Similarly, we observed annotators choosing similar labels but at different levels of specificity in the taxonomy (e.g. annotator 1 assigning a label of Matter INLINEFORM0 Changes of State INLINEFORM1 Boiling, where annotator 2 assigned Matter INLINEFORM2 Changes of State), which occurred in 12% of disagreements before resolution.
